verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents bulk adding and editing the Chart of Accounts via CSV upload from Company Settings, and supports class dimensions with unlimited Groups for Classes. That covers COA customization plus a class dimension, but nothing in the evidence describes how accounts are typed or nested. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of account-type configuration, sub-account hierarchy, tag dimensions beyond classes, in-app (non-CSV) COA editing details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
